course_description: This course provides an in-depth exploration of game development using Unity, equipping students with the skills to design, prototype, and build interactive experiences. Students will learn industry-standard software design principles, apply the software development lifecycle in a game development context, and develop structured Game Design Documents (GDDs). Through hands-on projects, they will implement game mechanics, optimize performance, and create engaging 2D and 3D prototypes. The course emphasizes iteration, teamwork, and problem-solving, preparing students to design immersive worlds while upholding ethical and professional standards. By the end of the semester, students will have developed a working game prototype that showcases their creativity and technical expertise.

course_learning_outcomes.text: describe and identify the core principles of immersive game world design while being capable of explaining foundational game design concepts;
demonstrate understanding of game logic, mechanics and gameplay design;
breakdown and categorize game ideas while analyzing feasibility of mechanics, illustrate and blueprint a game prototype;
determine and evaluate the use of animations, timelines and UI elements for game design;
assess and interpret how games can address social and environmental issues, evaluating existing games and creating new games that impact culture, inclusivity, and ethical considerations; and
design, develop, and synthesize all learned concepts into a fully functional game prototype.
